Assess the patient's social life, including their relationships, support systems, and social interactions, to understand how these factors may influence their overall health and diabetes management. 2. 3. Engage in advanced care planning by identifying the potential need for surrogate decision-makers who can make healthcare decisions on behalf of the patient if they become unable to do so. 4. Discuss and establish advanced directives with the patient, which outline their preferences for medical care and treatment in situations where they may not be able to communicate their wishes.
